svg.aria-label: Three double stops on the violin A and E strings: a 5th, a major 3rd and a 6th, on the staff and on the fingerboard
svg.text: Double stops on the A and E strings
1st position. The two notes sound together; the finger shape across the strings sets the interval.
Nut on the left; “ahead” = towards the bridge. Numbers are fingers (colours as in the Grade 1 map).
